# House price data: loading and sampling

```{r house-data}
house_raw <- read.csv("data/kc_house_data.csv")

house_features <- c(
  "bedrooms",
  "bathrooms",
  "sqft_living",
  "sqft_lot",
  "floors",
  "yr_built"
)

house_model_data <- house_raw[, c(house_features, "price")]
house_model_data <- na.omit(house_model_data)

set.seed(123)
house_sample <- house_model_data[sample(nrow(house_model_data), 2000), ]

kable(head(house_sample), caption = "Random sample of 2000 observations used for house price modeling.")
```
